findings.body: If it is a new embodiment and unseen task, you can try two-stage training. First, turn off tune_llm and tune_visual and train action head only, it helps the action head to warm up on the new action space. Then turn on tune_llm and tune_visual, it helps the model to better adapt to the new task. If you turn on all parameters from the beginning, the action can be very noisy and may cause loss spikes.
